messages:
mira: Quick Q — I'm bringing two guests Saturday around 4pm for a 30m product walkthrough. They might drop an oversized box (poster/stand) at the lobby earlier. Do we need them pre-registered for badges or can front desk handle walk-ins? Also any hotdesk recs near a monitor?

julian: I can cover the desk on Sat until 5. Walk-ins are fine but pre-registering saves time. If you DM me names I can queue them in the visitor system and have temp stickers ready.

alex: If it's a poster box, please ask courier to leave it for Mira and label it with your name. We have locker #3 for early drops. I'll move it upstairs when I'm in.

mira: Thanks — I'll tell courier to label "Mira - Sat demo". Poster might be a long tube or a flat box, courier wasn't specific.

shipping-bot: New delivery logged: carrier=RedRider, ETA=Sat 12:30, size=large box, recipient=Mira. Locker suggestion: #3.

tammy: Seating poll: window hotdesk (A7) or Quiet Room 2 (bookable, projector)? React with :one: for window, :two: for quiet room.

ryan: :two: Quiet room — less hallway noise for recordings.

alex: :one: Window hotdesk works if it's just a quick walkthrough and they want a casual vibe.

julian: :two: Quiet room if projector or slides are needed.

mira: leaning :two: — we might play a short recording. Rare to need projector for this but good to have.

frontdesk-bot: Temp visitor stickers will be printed in yellow. Pre-registered names received by 3:30pm will have express check-in.

julian: I'll print 2 stickers and keep them at the desk. If courier drops earlier, I'll put the box in locker #3 and ping Mira.

mira: Perfect — I'll DM the courier to add locker label and text me on arrival. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
